messages:
ana_dev: Quick preflight — I'm planning to land a small Terraform change to provision a mixed-GPU node pool for the model-p3 workload. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/482. High level: reserved capacity on H100s (2 nodes), spot burst pool on G5s, plus autoscaler tuning and taints/tolerations. Can folks skim for secret wiring and eviction behavior?

ben_infra: lgtm conceptually. Couple quick q's: 1) how are you modelling capacity reservations in the TF module? 2) what's the spot eviction fallback (automated to dedicated pool?), 3) do we need zoneAffinity / spread constraints to avoid AZ hot-spot?

chloe_sre: ops note: ensure GPU-operator certs secret is populated in kube-system and daemonset references it. Also add a PDB for critical infra pods so scaling/drain doesn't cascade.

ana_dev: (typo) -- ignore

ana_dev: sorry, meant ana_dev: Answers: capacity reservation is a small var-driven block (reserved_count = 2) with an open reservation so nodes are guaranteed but still shareable. Spot pool is tainted with `gpu-spot=true:NoSchedule` and batch jobs have the toleration. Fallback is handled by scheduler + nodeSelector `pool=dedicated-gpu` on critical services; autoscaler policy prefers dedicated if spot nodes are gone. Quick TF snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_instance" "gpu_reserved" {
  count = var.reserved_count
  instance_type = var.reserved_type
n  # ensure we land capacity reservations
  capacity_reservation_specification {
    capacity_reservation_preference = "open"
  }
}
```
(note: real module uses aws_launch_template + capacity_reservation_target in aws_autoscaling_group)

ben_infra: tiny nit: lifecycle ignore_changes on `tag` and `ebs_block_device` recommended. Also ensure cluster-autoscaler config has `--scale-down-delay-after-add=10m` for gpu pools (avoid thrash). For AZ spread: add a label `gpu_az` and a soft topologySpreadConstraint.

mike_platform: I'll add an infra-test that simulates a spot termination and validates pod migration to the reserved pool. Ping me after you push the final TF change so I can wire the test.

k8s-bot: K8s manifest lint passed: gpu-daemonset.yaml ✅

terraform-bot: Terraform plan completed in sandbox — changes confined to module `gpu_pool`. No drift detected elsewhere.

ana_dev: (again sorry) -- accidental message

ana_dev: ana_dev: Uploaded updated TF with lifecycle block, added autoscaler tuning, and a README section for secret wiring: `kubectl create secret generic gpu-operator-certs --from-file=certs/` under ops/README.md. Also added notes about tolerations and the fallback nodeSelector for critical deployments.

chloe_sre: please add runbook pointer for spot drain events: ops/playbooks/gpu-drain.sh and post an alert to #eng-oncall when the autoscaler starts draining nodes.

ben_infra: approving the infra change from infra side. @mike_platform please comment on PR to trigger CI + infra-e2e. I'll leave the final merge to ana_dev after CI green.

ana_dev: ana_dev: thanks! will merge after CI. tagging for visibility @here :shipit:

deploy-bot: deploy started for infra-pr-482 to sandbox at 2140032155

ana_dev: ana_dev: merge done. monitoring autoscaler and kube events for the next 30m. thanks all.

k8s-bot: Alert: spot-pool-node-42 terminated by AWS (simulated event) — node cordoned and pods rescheduled to dedicated pool.

chloe_sre: Observed no pod failures during the simulated termination. autoscaler moved pods to reserved nodes as expected. Good smoke test.

ben_infra: nice. I'll follow up with a small TF cleanup PR to add the lifecycle ignore_changes and topology spread suggestion.

ana_dev: ana_dev: will open follow-up for the small cleanup and add test pins for instance types. Closing the preflight — thanks everyone!
